name: native-float
description: Native Float — a macOS Tahoe+ SwiftUI style that feels like a real Apple app. Uses system fonts, native materials, native toolbar behavior. Identity comes from the HoverToggles cluster (one cohesive, collapsible toolbar item: appearance/opacity/magnet/pin with uniform 30pt geometry) and the frosted sidebar treatment (ultraThinMaterial, capsule search, traffic lights on sidebar, gear + title inline).
author: Tyler
